description: This file contains utility functions related to chat session filtering and display, notably generating human-friendly session labels and resolving a list of recent chat sessions based on various criteria.

methods.name: friendlySessionName
methods.description: Converts a raw session key into a human-readable label, handling common prefixes and formatting words.

methods.name: resolveSessionChoices
methods.description: Generates a list of chat session entries based on recent activity, main session, and current session, applying filtering criteria.
